title: Metabolic profiling with HUMAnN
author: Curtis Huttenhower
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.d9799m

steps.title: Run translated search against KEGG
steps.instruction: Execute a translated search of your sequences against the KEGG database using blastx or usearch.

steps.title: Place BLAST results in input
steps.instruction: Copy the translated BLAST results, identified by KEGG gene IDs, into the HUMAnN input directory; files may be gzipped or bzipped, and additional formats can be enabled by editing the SConstruct file.

steps.title: Execute HUMAnN with scons
steps.instruction: Run the scons command to start HUMAnN analysis, optionally adding `-j N` to parallelize across N cores; results will be written to the `output` directory.

steps.title: Merge metabolic abundance tables
steps.instruction: Create an output folder and run the merge script to combine individual HUMAnN profiling files into a single abundance table.
